scoring: Answer key for comparing Vista (LLM review) with Prowler (rule-based scanner). It holds facts and published AWS Security Hub FSBP control severities only; it contains no ratings of its own. A tool's output is matched to a scenario by the identifier in terraform output scenario_resources (the API ID). condition flaw: reporting the scenario counts as a detection. condition flaw_blocked: a misconfiguration is present but another deployed control removes the path it opens; reporting it is shown as a separate report rate, counted as neither a detection nor a false positive. condition hardened: no misconfiguration was planted; reporting it is a false positive. fsbp lists the FSBP controls that fail because of the scenario's configuration: a setting in which the scenario differs from its module's hardened default, or a resource its configuration associates with it (its stages, routes, and integrations). fsbp_severity is the highest published severity in that list. On coverage fsbp scenarios the reported severity (NONE when the scenario is not reported) is compared with fsbp_severity on the order NONE < LOW < MEDIUM < HIGH < CRITICAL; outside_fsbp scenarios are scored for detection and false positives only. Controls in baseline_controls fail regardless of scenario and are in no scenario's fsbp. scripts/score.py applies these rules.

baseline_controls.note: FSBP controls known to fail regardless of scenario, for example account-level settings, the VPCs the scenario resources run in, settings left at the module's hardened default that every scenario starts from, and deletion protection, which every resource leaves off so one terraform destroy removes everything. The list is not exhaustive: other FSBP controls can also fail regardless of scenario, depending on account settings at scan time. They are in no scenario's fsbp list. Backing resources no scenario is scored on (for example the S3 access-log bucket, the DynamoDB table, the SQS queue, the KMS key) are not evaluated here.

controls.scope: No client certificate for backend authentication on the prod stage of all eight REST APIs

controls.title: API Gateway REST API stages should have AWS X-Ray tracing enabled
controls.scope: X-Ray tracing off on the prod stage of all eight REST APIs

scenarios.title: IAM-authenticated API with no access logging
scenarios.description: Regional REST API whose GET /items route uses AWS_IAM authorization and calls DynamoDB Scan on the shared table through an execution role limited to that action, with request validation, a WAF web ACL on stage prod, stage throttling (rate 25, burst 50), and execution logging at ERROR. Misconfigured: the prod stage has no access log destination.

scenarios.title: Execution logging records full request and response bodies
scenarios.description: Regional REST API whose GET /items route uses AWS_IAM authorization and calls DynamoDB Scan on the shared table through an execution role limited to that action, with request validation, a WAF web ACL on stage prod, stage throttling (rate 25, burst 50), and access logging. Misconfigured: method settings for */* set dataTraceEnabled true and logging level INFO.

scenarios.title: IAM-authenticated API with no WAF and no throttling
scenarios.description: Regional REST API whose GET /items route uses AWS_IAM authorization and calls DynamoDB Scan on the shared table through an execution role limited to that action, with request validation, access logging, and execution logging at ERROR on stage prod. Misconfigured: the prod stage has no WAF web ACL, and method settings set the throttling rate and burst limits to -1 (no stage throttle).

fsbp.title: API Gateway should be associated with a WAF Web ACL
fsbp.scope: prod stage has no WAF web ACL

scenarios.title: Route with no authorization reads the DynamoDB table
scenarios.description: Regional REST API deployed to stage prod with a WAF web ACL, stage throttling, request validation, and access and execution logging. Misconfigured: GET /items has authorization type NONE and calls DynamoDB Scan on the shared table through the execution role.

scenarios.title: Routes with no authorization read, write, and delete DynamoDB items
scenarios.description: Regional REST API deployed to stage prod with a WAF web ACL, stage throttling, request validation, and access and execution logging. Misconfigured: GET, PUT, and DELETE /items have authorization type NONE and call DynamoDB Scan, PutItem, and DeleteItem through the execution role.

scenarios.title: Cognito-protected API with an anonymous MOCK health check
scenarios.description: Regional REST API whose GET and PUT /items routes use a Cognito user pool authorizer, with a WAF web ACL, stage throttling, request validation, and access and execution logging; GET /health has authorization type NONE and a MOCK integration that returns a fixed response without calling a backend. Hardened: no misconfiguration was planted.

scenarios.title: Partner API whose routes require only an API key
scenarios.description: Regional REST API with a usage plan (rate 10, burst 20, quota 100,000 requests per month) and one API key, plus a WAF web ACL, stage throttling, and logging. Misconfigured: GET and PUT /items have authorization type NONE with api_key_required true, and call DynamoDB Scan and PutItem through the execution role.

scenarios.title: Unauthenticated admin API restricted to the office IP range
scenarios.description: Regional REST API deployed to stage prod with a WAF web ACL, stage throttling, request validation, and access and execution logging. Misconfigured: GET and DELETE /items have authorization type NONE and call DynamoDB Scan and DeleteItem through the execution role.
scenarios.context: The REST API resource policy allows execute-api:Invoke for Principal * and explicitly denies it when aws:SourceIp is not in var.office_cidr (default 203.0.113.0/24).

scenarios.title: HTTP API webhook route with no authorization that writes to SQS
scenarios.description: HTTP API whose route POST /webhooks/payments has an AWS_PROXY integration (SQS-SendMessage) that sends the request body to an SQS queue through a role limited to sqs:SendMessage on that queue; the $default stage has route throttling (rate 10, burst 20) and access logging. Misconfigured: the route has authorization type NONE.

fsbp.title: API Gateway routes should specify an authorization type
fsbp.scope: Route POST /webhooks/payments has authorization type NONE
